changeSet.author: nexus-edjmu
changeSet.comment: pdf_pipeline gains pipeline_id (BIGINT identity, stamped onto every existing row by the ADD) and keyed_by ('content_hash' for every existing row, 'document' for identity="document" creates); PRIMARY KEY moves from (tenant_id, content_hash) to (tenant_id, pipeline_id); UNIQUE (tenant_id, content_hash, collection, pdf_path) makes one row per document; the partial unique index pdf_pipeline_legacy_uq keeps one row per hash for legacy-keyed rows, atomically, as the old PRIMARY KEY did. DDL only: no existing row is modified or removed (the identity ADD assigns new values to a new column), so no DATA EFFECT.

changeSet.author: nexus-edjmu
changeSet.comment: pdf_pages and pdf_chunks gain pipeline_id, backfilled from their owning pdf_pipeline row by (tenant_id, content_hash) (deterministic: pre-002 state has one row per hash); WAL rows with no owning row are deleted; PRIMARY KEY moves to (tenant_id, pipeline_id, page_index|chunk_index); FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, pipeline_id) REFERENCES pdf_pipeline ON DELETE CASCADE; content_hash is dropped from both WAL tables so no hash-scoped WAL query can exist. Toggles FORCE RLS off on pdf_pipeline, pdf_pages and pdf_chunks for the DML (nexus_admin owns them with no BYPASSRLS) and restores it LIFO before the constraints. DATA EFFECT: UPDATEs pdf_pages.pipeline_id and pdf_chunks.pipeline_id (new column, NULL) for every WAL row whose (tenant_id, content_hash) matches a pdf_pipeline row; DELETEs every pdf_pages and pdf_chunks row with no matching pdf_pipeline row (already unreachable through the API, which reads the WAL only via a live pipeline row); DROPs COLUMN content_hash from pdf_pages and pdf_chunks (the value is re-derivable from the parent row via pipeline_id, which is exactly what the rollback below does). Reversible via the rollback for every row that survives; the parentless rows are gone for good.

changeSet.author: nexus-edjmu
changeSet.comment: Column comments for pdf_pipeline.pipeline_id, pdf_pipeline.keyed_by, pdf_pages.pipeline_id and pdf_chunks.pipeline_id. Comments only, no DDL beyond COMMENT ON COLUMN.
